title: Dev toolchains, preinstalled
body: Neovim (LazyVim), VS Code, Zsh, and runtimes for Python, Node, Go, Rust, and C++. Docker, Podman, and kubectl are ready on first boot.

title: Hyprland desktop, tuned
body: A Wayland tiling setup with Catppuccin Mocha, waybar, walker, and sensible keybindings. No dotfile archaeology required.

title: Rolling release, safe upgrades
body: Packages update continuously from the ShedOS repository. Your edited dotfiles are never silently overwritten — conflicts surface in a merge review instead.

title: BTRFS + LUKS, out of the box
body: Subvolumes and snapshots are set up by the installer, with optional full-disk encryption. Roll back a bad upgrade in seconds.
